test_title: PYST 76: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined part in the following sentence.

The entire speech of the revivalist __fell flat with__ the crowd that was present there.

options.text: had somewhat of a result on

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. had no effect on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "fell flat"** means that something failed to generate the desired effect or impact, so the correct replacement is** "had no effect on."**
 
• The other options imply varying levels of impact, which contradict the meaning of **"fell flat"**:
 
 
• "Had a great impact on" means it was very influential.
 
• "Had moderate influence on" suggests some level of impact.
 
• "Had somewhat of a result on" implies there was some effect.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
